COM.note: No authentication service, e-signature or PKI is mentioned.
The PIN reform centralises civil registry data, but no link to a separate national ID system is stated.
No count or share of people holding an ID is given.
The PIN is not said to be given at birth registration.
Nothing on who operates or maintains an ID system.
Interoperability with other state systems is planned but no register keyed on the PIN is named.

facts.fact: On 25 March 2026 Comoros authorities validated preparatory studies in Moroni for digitising the civil registry, introducing a unique Personal Identification Number as the cornerstone of citizen identity, under the Amecc programme funded by the French Embassy with UNICEF support.
